name: 15Five
summary: 15Five bundles reviews, OKRs and weekly check-ins in its Perform plan at $11 per user per month, billed annually. Total Platform costs $16 and Engage costs $4. AI coaching, note-taking and compensation tools are priced as separate add-ons.

facts.text: The Perform product page says a review cycle can be built and launched in less than 15 minutes, with different cycles for different departments or roles.
Pricing page: weekly check-ins, 1-on-1s and feedback requests are listed under Perform.

15Five's security page says it was audited against the SOC 2 framework and that SAML single sign-on works with providers such as Okta and Azure, included on some plans and sold as an add-on on others.
15Five Engage is listed at $4 per user per month, billed annually. The Perform plan costs $11 and the Total Platform plan $16.

15Five states that engagement survey responses are confidential, not anonymous. Responses are linked to employee accounts internally, and results appear only as aggregated groups of at least 5 respondents by default.
Admins can lower the 15Five reporting threshold to 3 or 4, which makes respondents in small groups easier to identify.

plans.name: Perform
plans.notes: Reviews, OKRs, check-ins, 1-on-1s and feedback requests. Billed annually

hiddenCosts: Manager Products Content costs $49 per manager per month and Kona Coach costs $19 per manager per month.
Kona Notetaker costs $2 per employee per month.
Compensation costs $9 per user per month, or $11 with salary benchmarking.
Some optional add-ons carry minimum requirements the page does not state.
